title: The Late Inheritance
author: Dominic Crane
blurb: Oscar Voss, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
